experimental_design.evidence: inferred: We conducted a global proteomics analysis on kidney organoids at three distinct culture time points: day 22, day 33, and day 38.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Kidney organoid samples (days 22, 32, and 38 of differentiation) were pooled (n=16 organoids, obtained from 25 K cells at day 10)

number_of_fractions.evidence: The remaining pellet was resuspended in 50 µL of TEAB/SDS lysis buffer (100 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB) pH 8.5, 10% sodium dodecyl sulfate in 9mL LC-MS grade water) by repetitive pipetting, and the samples were subjected to sonication using Covaris AFA glass tubes in the Covaris LE220+ system.

technology_type.evidence: Sample preparation for label-free mass spectrometry-based proteomics involves digesting samples (overnight) with Trypsin Gold (Promega, V528A) in S-Trap Spin Columns, followed by purification using OLIGO R3 Reverse beads in acetonitrile (ACN).
